comment: Both increase/moderate; model omits e23 and e56 (both +1), and no edge has an opposite sign.
Both no_effect/moderate with the same five edges and signs.
Both mixed/very_low with the same woody-debris and slash edges and signs.
Both no_evidence: hatchery genetic diversity is not a Shannon/evenness index.
Both decrease/moderate from glyphosate diversity edges e1 and e8; richness excluded.
Model counts water table position as soil water content (mixed/very_low); I treat water table as a separate class and soil anoxia as not moisture, so no_evidence.
Both no_evidence; active layer depth, canopy openness and the calendar temperature trend excluded.
Model drops the lake trout rehabilitation-trend edges (e15/e45/e56 +1) as calendar year, giving no_effect; with them I get mixed. Certainty is low in both.
Both decrease/low; model drops the elk time-since-release edges, but its e12/e23 match mine and nothing is opposite.
Identical edge set and signs; both mixed/very_low.

Model signs e4/e13 +1 from ordination-axis loadings and omits the biocontrol time-passage nulls (e35/e45), giving increase; I set e4/e13 to null, include e35/e45 as 0, and get mixed. Certainty is very_low in both.
Both mixed/low with e25 +1, e53 +1, e57 -1; NPP excluded.
Same nine deer/moose edges and signs; both decrease/moderate.
Both no_evidence: no amendment cause with a reproductive outcome.
Both increase/moderate; model excludes liming and I include it, but every shared edge has the same sign.
Model counts submergent and bryophyte cover as native abundance (increase/low); I keep only drainage-to-native-cover e38 (increase/very_low). Certainty differs, and no edge is opposite.
Both no_evidence: no temperature/microclimate cause with a composition outcome.
Both no_evidence; e54 is reversed.
Both no_evidence: seedling diameter read as tree growth, not stand structure or basal area.
Both increase/very_low; I also include e7 (+1), which is not opposite.
